remarks: Quiet and secure 12 unit elevator building in the heart of South Norwalk w/private garage spot, guest parking, and storage. Renovated 890 sq ft condo boasts new hardwood floors, open kitchen w/quartz countertops and new appliances. Huge living/dining space w/room for home office. Large bedroom that includes a huge walk-in closet. Stay comfortable year round with central A/C and efficient gas heat. Immerse yourself in all that SoNo has to offer, all within walking distance. From the SoNo Collection mall, amazing restaurants, South Norwalk harbor, dog friendly Oyster Shell Park, renovated Maritime Aquarium and the movie theater. This location is an ideal combination of easy living, while enjoying all the best of South Norwalk at your fingertips. Pets welcome!
